title: Removing Part Sales makes new part sales follow again
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Three active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A}, {Sales-rep-B} and {Sales-rep-C}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able, {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able and {Sales-rep-C} is ZZAUTOTEST Cara Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} shows "Sales Representative - Service Labor" {Sales-rep-A}, "Sales Representative - Service Parts" {Sales-rep-B} and "Sales Representative - Part Sales" {Sales-rep-C}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Starting screen: {Customer-A}'s page is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open Edit Customer, click the remove x beside "Sales Representative - Part Sales" and save.
  2. Create a new part sale for {Customer-A} and look at its Sales Representative field.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the customer saves with no Part Sales field.
  • Step 2: the new part sale starts with {Sales-rep-B}, the Service Parts person.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 10 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 20 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R12: “Removing Part Sales makes new part sales follow again (S4-R26).”
  • S4-R26: “A new part sale starts with the customer's Part Sales field when it is added: the person picked, or "Unassigned" when "Unassigned" was picked. Without a Part Sales field it starts with the Service Parts person, or the one representative when the customer is not split.”
